note: Crawford County (IL) publishes no queryable zoning districts. The county seat, Robinson, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF converted from DWG (2016); no ArcGIS REST or GeoJSON zoning layer found for Robinson, Palestine, Hutsonville or Oblong. County GIS is a Schneider Beacon parcel viewer with no zoning layer. ArcGIS searches for Crawford County zoning returned nothing official.
